notes: No breadboard is used; the sensor breakout is wired directly to the Arduino with hook-up wires, as in the circuit image.

The schematic crosses D6 and D7: D6 goes to DRDY and D7 goes to CSB. This matches the code (dataReadyPin=6, chipSelectPin=7). The code's header comment has these two the other way round, so I followed the schematic and code.
The red wire goes from the Arduino 3.3V pin to the sensor Vcc. I mapped it to the catalogue port '3.3V' on the scp1000.
The black wire goes to a GND pin on the Arduino power header. I used GND.1, since the image doesn't say which GND pin.
The Arduino is not shown with a USB cable in the diagram, so none is added.
